cover_letter:
Dear Go Vocal team,

I'm writing to apply for the Digital Marketer (Demand Gen / Growth Marketing) role. Your mission to make public decision-making more inclusive and participatory speaks to me personally, and I'm excited by the opportunity to own qualified pipeline and drive growth experiments that support that mission.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content to grow organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads. I also work in a CRM for a cleaning-services client, keeping customer records and follow-up up to date. This hands-on experience across SEO, content, web, and analytics has given me a solid foundation in digital marketing.

On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This project reflects my curiosity for new tools and my ability to ship experiments end to end.

I'm eager to deepen my skills in demand gen experimentation and AI leverage. I'm comfortable learning new tools like n8n, Make, and Clay, and I'm excited to apply them to scale what works. I work remotely from Belgium (CET) and thrive in collaborative, mission-driven environments.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my background and drive can contribute to Go Vocal's growth. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
